purpose: Frozen single-note ablation; diagnostic items and new project items reported separately

poems.title: 登鹳雀楼
poems.author: 王之涣
poems.single_note: li is a traditional Chinese unit of distance; a thousand li evokes a vast view here and need not be converted to an exact measurement.
other_notes: 依山尽 depicts the sun sinking out of sight along or behind the mountains.
穷 means taking in the full extent of the view, not poverty.
更上一层楼 links climbing higher to seeing farther.
terms: 太阳沿山或山后落下；不要求逐字使用 lean
千里目为广远视野；miles、li 或不保留单位的自然表达均可，不因没有单位注释扣分
穷为尽览、尽收眼底；take in、see farther 等功能对等表达均可
relations: 欲穷与更上保留目的和手段
数词保留诗性广远感；不要求显式解释 hyperbole
山、河海与登高的空间关系未反转

poems.title: 枫桥夜泊
poems.author: 张继
poems.single_note: 愁眠 refers to the traveler lying down in sorrow; the river maples and fishing lights face or accompany the sorrowful traveler, rather than naming another person or place.
other_notes: 姑苏 is an old name for Suzhou.
寒山寺 is Hanshan Temple outside Suzhou; Cold Mountain Temple is an acceptable translated name.
渔火 means lights on fishing boats.
terms: 寒山寺为寺院专名，Hanshan/Cold Mountain Temple均可
渔火为捕鱼或渔船灯火，fishing lights也可
relations: 月落、乌啼、霜保持并置而非虚构因果
寺钟声传到旅人船上，不反转方向
景物与怀愁而卧的旅人构成相对/相伴；合理单一解读满分，不强制两种解释

poems.title: 商山早行
poems.author: 温庭筠
text: 晨起动征铎，客行悲故乡。
鸡声茅店月，人迹板桥霜。
槲叶落山路，枳花明驿墙。
因思杜陵梦，凫雁满回塘。
poems.single_note: 杜陵 is a place near Chang'an, evoking the home region the traveler longs for; it is not a person's name here.
other_notes: 征铎 are bells on animals or vehicles used on a journey.
槲叶 are oak leaves; 枳花 are the pale blossoms of the trifoliate orange.
凫雁 are wild ducks and geese; 回塘 is a curving pond.
terms: 杜陵保留地名或故乡地域，不写成人名
槲叶与枳花为叶落/花明的植物意象，oak与orange类可接受，不要求植物学专名
凫雁与回塘保留水鸟和曲塘意象
relations: 客行与悲故乡为旅途乡愁，不变成愉快归家
鸡声、月、足迹、霜为清晨意象，不添加不必要因果
末联从眼前旅景转入思念或梦中杜陵，不写成眼前已抵家

poems.title: 竹里馆
poems.author: 王维
poems.single_note: 琴 here is the traditional Chinese qin, a plucked string instrument often translated as a Chinese zither, not a Western piano.
other_notes: 幽篁 is a secluded bamboo grove.
长啸 is a long clear vocal sound, often rendered as whistling or chanting.
相照 describes the bright moon shining on the solitary speaker.
terms: 琴为qin/zither类，不能是西式钢琴
长啸可为whistle/chant等长声，不强行限定唯一英文词
relations: 独坐保持孤独独处而不是众人相聚
深林人不知为无人知晓/无他人知晓，不误写诗人不认识别人
月照诗人并有陪伴意味，照射方向正确
